title: Design System: WIUC 2026 Bratislava schedule helper

sign-muted.note: 72% white on navy; the second text colour on any signboard surface.

display.purpose: The destination: university name on the signboard, picker and panel titles. 30px from 640px.

numeral.purpose: Match time, day number, hall number. 27px (time) / 28px (gate) from 640px; the hall plate uses 22px, 26px from 640px.

headline.purpose: Section titles on the ground: venue groups, Slovak universities, organiser PDFs.

title.purpose: The match line; own university at 800 inside it. 16px from 640px. School names use 700, venue names 800 at 16px.

body.purpose: Leads (14px), notes (13px), meta lines (12.5px), buttons (14px/700), capsules (13px/700).

label.purpose: The sport line heading every row, uppercase, in the zone label colour; gate weekday and picker country are 600 variants.

caption.purpose: Unit word under the plate number (HALA / KURT / IHRISKO / MAPA); category under the time at 600; badges at 800.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Every row, card, school button, PDF link and the next row at rest.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A plate raised by state: the live row and a hovered school button, with translateY(-2px) / (-1px).

shadows.name: ring-live
shadows.purpose: The live row at rest; pulses to 0 0 0 6px at 45% yellow (keyframes ring, 2s ease-out infinite).

shadows.name: ring-home
shadows.purpose: The remembered university in the picker, static.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Search field focus halo together with a Gate Blue border; all other controls use the 3px solid outline.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Every state transition: background, border, colour, transform, box-shadow, opacity.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: The only easing in the system.

motion.name: ring-pulse
motion.purpose: The live row's yellow ring breathing between 2.5px solid and 6px at 45%.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion everything is switched off, including the live pulse.

darkScheme.note: Follows prefers-color-scheme; forced with data-theme="light" | "dark" on <html>. Stripe palette, Gate Blue and badge colours do not change.

stripeBand.note: Seven equal segments under the header; lime and stripe cyan are zone colours only.

iconSet.stroke: currentColor 2px, round caps and joins, no fill

narrative.overview:
Every screen is a wayfinding sign on the way to a hall. The page is read while walking between Bratislava venues, on a phone, often outdoors or in a loud hall, by someone who has seconds to decide where to go next. So the system borrows the grammar of stadium signage: a deep navy signboard shell with white type for everything that names a destination (header, university name, day gates, hall plates), a flat light ground for the rows, and the WIUC stripe palette as the colour of the sport zones, never as decoration. Big tabular numerals (time, day number, hall number) are the loudest thing on the page; prose is small and grey and stays out of the way.

The voice is fast, legible while walking, tournament-coloured, and never official-looking. It is an unofficial helper and must not read as the organiser's site: it uses the organiser's colour language and stripe motif, not their logo or photography. Density is high but every row has the same anatomy, so the eye learns the column positions once and then scans top to bottom like a departure board. The one moving thing on the page is the live row, which lifts and glows yellow; everything else is still.

Confirmed rejections: no same-size white cards with a coloured left border and a small time label (the category default the build refuses); no entrance choreography; no glyph or icon-font icons; no photography.
keyCharacteristics: Navy signboard surfaces carry white type only; the light grey ground carries lifted white rows.
Colour is content: a sport's zone colour appears as the row's full-height zone band, the capsule dot and the sport line, never as a card background.
Numbers lead the type ramp: times and day numbers at 24 to 28px, hall numbers at 22 to 26px, all weight 800, tabular, tight.
One glowing state: only live rows lift with a pulsing Stripe Yellow ring; past rows dim to 50%.
Capsules for filters and actions, plates for destinations: 999px pills on the ground, square navy plates inside 12px rows.
Light by day, navy-black by night: both schemes are required and both are tokenised on `:root`.

rules.name: The Zone Band Rule
rules.body: A sport's colour is content, not chrome. It appears in exactly three places: the 8px full-height zone band inside the row, the 10px dot in the sport capsule, and the sport line's text and icon. It never fills a card, a button or a badge, and it never colours body text.

rules.name: The Readable Zone Rule
rules.body: Light zone colours (yellow, orange, lime, green, cyan, pink, red) are too pale for 12px text on white, so each carries a darker label colour (`t` in the sport map, set as `--zt`) used for the sport line in the light scheme. At night the sport line switches to the raw zone colour (`--z`), which reads on navy. Dark zones (purple, floorball blue, Gate Blue, navy) use themselves in both schemes.

rules.name: The Signboard Rule
rules.body: Navy surfaces carry white type only (Sign Ink at full strength, Sign Muted for the second line). Controls on a navy surface are transparent or 12% white with a 35 to 50% white border; the selected one turns Gate Blue. Nothing on navy is grey.

rules.name: The Status Trio Rule
rules.body: Three stripe colours double as status: Stripe Yellow means "now / yours" (live row, today dot, remembered home school), Stripe Green means "up next", Stripe Red means "the live time and a score". No fourth status colour; everything else is Muted.

rules.name: The Night Flip Rule
rules.body: The dark scheme flips the neutrals (ground `#07131d`, card `#0f2232`, card-2 `#142b3e`, line `#243648`, ink `#eef3f8`, ink-2 `#c3cedb`, muted `#93a3b5`), deepens the signboard to `#020d16`, moves Live Ink to Stripe Yellow and the focus ring to Signal Cyan. The stripe palette, Gate Blue and the two badge colours do not change. The flip follows `prefers-color-scheme` and can be forced with `data-theme` on `<html>`.

rules.name: The Big Number Rule
rules.body: On a mobile screen the match time and the day number (24px) are the largest type, ahead of the destination and the hall number (both 22px); only the desktop destination (30px) outranks them. Prose never reaches numeral size: the biggest non-numeric text below the destination is the 17px headline.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on `body` and inherited everywhere, so times, counts and scores line up in columns and do not shift as the minute changes.

rules.name: The Tight-Then-Open Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows (-0.03em on numerals, -0.02em on display, -0.01em on headlines) and opens as size shrinks (0.04 to 0.1em on uppercase labels and captions). Body text stays at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Lifted Row Rule
rules.body: Rows rest at the Rest shadow and lift only in response to state: live, or a pointer over a school button. Nothing lifts on page load, and nothing else lifts on hover.

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow means lift plus a pulsing ring, and only a live row has it; when several matches overlap, each live row glows and nothing else does. The next row and the home school share the ring device at rest (2px, static, Rest shadow) but never the lift or the pulse. A pulsing or lifted element that is not a live row is a defect.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are black alpha only. Colour sits in rings and bands, never in a shadow.

dos: Do put every destination on navy and every list on the ground: header, destination panel, gate strip and hall plates are Navy Signboard with white type; rows and cards are white plates on Ground.
Do carry a sport's colour as the 8px zone band, the capsule dot and the sport line, with the darker label colour (`--zt`) for light zones in the light scheme and the raw zone colour at night.
Do set times and day numbers in Numeral (800, 24px, -0.03em, tabular, line-height 1) and hall numbers in the same style at 22px, and keep them ahead of every line of prose.
Do use the Rest shadow (`0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.08)`) on every plate and the Lift shadow only for the live row and a hovered school button.
Do reserve Stripe Yellow for "now / yours", Stripe Green for "up next" and Gate Blue for the single selected or primary control on a screen.
Do use the two radii only: 12px plates for surfaces, 999px capsules for controls and badges; let plates and bands inside a row stay square and be clipped by the row.
Do draw icons from the authored 24-unit stroke set (2px round stroke, no fill) at 15, 18, 20 or 22px.
Do animate only state changes, at 180ms ease-out, and switch everything off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do separate meta values with a spaced middot (venue · group · count) and never with an em-dash in UI text.
donts: Don't fill a card, button or badge with a sport's zone colour, or colour body text with it.
Don't pulse or lift anything that is not a live row; live is the one glowing state.
Don't put grey text on navy; use Sign Ink or Sign Muted (72% white) only.
Don't tint a shadow or use a shadow in place of the state rings; shadows are black alpha, rings are colour.
Don't add borders to rows, cards or plates; the 1.5px Line border belongs to capsules, chips and the search field.
Don't change the sign row's four-column anatomy between views or days; the full schedule and the university view share the same row.
Don't introduce a second typeface, italics, a display face, icon fonts or glyph icons, or photography and the organiser's logo.
Don't add entrance animations, parallax or scroll effects; the page must work on older phones and read instantly.
